historical_references.reference: Sunayyan ibn Ubayd Allah al-Qadri was a renowned Sufi scholar and poet from Andalusia, Spain. He was a disciple of Ibn al-Arabi and is known for his poetic work 'al-Sama` al-Sadiq' which is considered a masterpiece in Sufi poetry. His teachings greatly influenced the development of Sufi thought in the Maghreb region.
historical_references.context: Sufi thought and poetry in Spain

historical_references.reference: Sunayyan al-Mawsili was an important scholar and jurist in the Islamic Golden Age. He was born in Mosul, Iraq and studied under the influential scholar Ibn Taymiyyah. Sunayyan is known for his work in Islamic law, particularly his commentary on the Sahih of al-Bukhari. His contributions to Islamic jurisprudence were significant during the Mamluk period in Egypt.
historical_references.context: Development of Islamic law during the Mamluk period
